items.t: Citigroup Maintains Neutral on Air Products, Raises Price Target to $335
items.sum: Citigroup analyst Patrick Cunningham maintains Air Products (NYSE:APD) with a Neutral and raises the price target from $312 to $335.

items.t: Air Products and Chemicals Inc (APD) (Q4 2026) Earnings Call Highlights: Solid Fiscal 2026 ...
items.sum: Air Products and Chemicals Inc (APD) delivered 8% sales growth and 12% adjusted EPS growth in fiscal 2026 while guiding fiscal 2027 EPS to $14.15--$14.50 amid helium and nonoperating headwinds.

items.t: Amazon Joins Goldman Sachs’ Conviction List Alongside 4 Other Stock Picks
items.sum: Goldman Sachs just overhauled its Conviction List with five new additions, and the upside targets on some of these picks will raise eyebrows. One hyperscaler alone carries a 51% potential gain, but it is far from the biggest number on the list.

items.t: YLDE: This Could Be A Good Fund For Income Investors, But Underperformance Is Possible
items.sum: Analyst sees YLDE as a fixed-income alternative, with a 7.23% yield and rising distributions, though it may lag the S&P 500 in bull markets.
